home.heroDescription: Join millions of students on their learning journey with Insel 1o1, the next-generation EdTech platform that makes education engaging, interactive, and rewarding.
home.powerfulFeatures: Why Students, Parents & Teachers Love Insel 1o1
home.featureDescription: A learning platform designed around real educational outcomes — not technology.

benefits.personalizedLearning: Personalized learning paths for every student

home.trackProgress: Track your progress with detailed analytics and insights
home.feature_adventureLearningDesc: Learning should feel like an adventure. Students explore islands, unlock new areas, complete challenges and discover knowledge through an engaging journey rather than traditional lessons.
home.feature_interactivePathsDesc: Structured learning paths guide students step-by-step through subjects and help them stay focused and motivated.
home.feature_personalProgressDesc: Track achievements, completed lessons and subject progress with clear visual indicators and meaningful feedback.
home.feature_parentInsightsDesc: Parents can easily monitor learning activity, progress, strengths and areas that may need additional support.
home.feature_teacherDashboardDesc: Teachers receive classroom insights, assignment tracking, student performance analytics and support indicators.
home.feature_motivationDesc: Achievements, rewards and learning milestones help students stay engaged and build positive learning habits.
home.feature_learnAnywhereDesc: Access learning content from desktop, tablet or smartphone and continue learning from anywhere.
home.feature_privacySecurityDesc: Safe learning environments, secure accounts and privacy-conscious design help protect students and families.
